items.name: Watercress Fest 2027
items.shortDescription: Come join the festivities on April 17th, 2027 from 10 a.m. - 4 p.m. at the Saline Courthouse Museum for the fourth installment of Watercress Fest! Watercress will feature cultural games and art demonstrations, conservation and ethnobotany tours, as well as a pop-up market, native food trucks and live music. The festival will center around our reltationship to land and water and feature conversations focusing on conservationism and stewardship of the Cherokee Nation Reservation.

items.name: Mock Jury presented by Zapp and the Saint Louis Art Fair 2027
items.shortDescription:
ZAPP and the Saint Louis Art Fair presented by Emerson are offering artists an opportunity to have their images critiqued through a Mock Jury workshop.  Whether you are new to the digital application process or looking to improve your jury submissions, all artists are welcome to attend and learn! 

This application will close once we reach 150 which is the maximum number of applicants that can be accepted to participate in the workshop.

items.name: 2027 BFA Broward Mural Mentorship
items.shortDescription:
CALL TO ARTISTS

 2027 BFA Broward Mural Mentorship Program

Call to Emerging Mural Artists: Paid Public Art Mentorship Opportunity

Business for the Arts Broward (BFA Broward) is seeking ten (10) emerging artists to participate in the 2026 Public Art Mentorship Program to create a mural located at 1401 Sistrunk Boulevard in Fort Lauderdale.

Participants will work alongside Lead Artist Mentors Lori Pratico and Nate Dee to execute approximately 2,835 square feet of public art across multiple wall surfaces. Artists will gain hands-on experience, large-scale painting, project planning, professional development, and public art best practices while contributing to a highly visible community artwork.

items.name: Art In The Pearl Fine Arts & Crafts Festival 2027
items.shortDescription:
The 31st annual Art In The Pearl Fine Arts & Crafts Festival takes place Labor Day weekend Saturday, September 4 through Monday, September 6, 2027. The show is located in the North Park Blocks of the Pearl District in Portland, Oregon. 140 exceptional visual artists have been selected to exhibit by an independent jury panel comprised of both working artists and art professionals. The Emerging Artist Program provides regional artists in the early stage of their art career an opportunity to gain experience marketing and showing their work. In addition to the exhibiting artists, the show offers art education, demonstrations and performance art.

 Art In The Pearl is a nonprofit organization founded and produced by a dedicated volunteer board of directors composed of local professional artists. Our focus is on promoting the arts, educating the public and strengthening creative and educational bonds with the community. A third of Art In The Pearl's budget is spent on marketing, and cultivating relationships and partnerships with local businesses to publicize and promote this well-loved long-standing festival.

We acknowledge that the history and culture of arts and crafts shows have not been inclusive to BIPOC artists historically and currently. We are working to dismantle this structure, and our own, to generate a more equitable space for artists and arts workers. All are welcome to our show and to apply. 
-Art In The Pearl Board of Directors

items.name: Tennessee Craft Fair Spring 2027 56th Annual - TN & Contiguous States
items.shortDescription:
Tennessee Craft invites you to apply to join us for our 56th SPRING ART FAIR! The Tennessee Craft fairs, is honored the top 100 premier art shows in the country. Attracting typically 45,000+ visitors, an opportunity to directly meet and engage patrons, collectors and the public. This juried art show presents traditional and contemporary fine craft art, handmade by 200+ regional artists, held outdoors, and is free admission to the public. The 2027 Spring fair is our Regional Show and will be held May 7-9 in the heart of Nashville on the beautiful Parthenon lawn of Centennial Park. The 56th Annual Spring Tennessee Craft Fair offers cash awards including a $1,000 Best of Show.
 
Please note: This event is open to Tennessee residents, residents from contiguous states, as well as artists studying at Tennessee academia institutions. Contiguous states include: Alabama, Arkansas, Georgia, Kentucky, Mississippi, Missouri, North Carolina and Virginia. If you are ineligible due to residency, please do not apply for this spring regional show. Instead, please wait to apply to the 2027 FALL Tennessee Craft Fair which will be held October 8-10, 2027 and is open to all artists who are residents and reside in the United States. The upcoming FALL application opens on April 15, 2027 on zapplication.org.

items.name: Double Decker Arts Festival 2027
items.shortDescription:
30th Annual Double Decker Arts Festival:
Taking its name from the town’s authentic double decker bus imported from England in 1994, the festival brings together visitors and residents alike for a day-long celebration of music, food, and the arts held on Oxford's picturesque Courthouse Square.

items.name: 19th Annual Wayne Art Center Plein Air Festival
items.shortDescription:
The Wayne Art Center Plein Air Festival is dedicated to enhancing the public's appreciation of works completed in the plein air method while providing a venue for established and emerging artists to share their work with collectors and the community.

Wayne Art Center's 19th Annual Plein Air Festival will take place May 2 through May 8, 2027, when 32 juried artists from across the country arrive to paint scenes within a 35-mile radius of Wayne, Pennsylvania, drawing inspiration from the historical architecture, cityscapes, waterfronts, and lush landscapes that define the area.  

Artwork resulting from the 7-day competition will be exhibited at the Wayne Art Center’s Collectors’ Preview and Sale on Saturday, May 8 and remains on exhibition through June 19, 2027.

This year’s esteemed juror, Kimball Geisler, will select 32 artists to participate and will award $25,000 in cash prizes.

items.name: The Eyes are Bigger Than the Stomach: Food and Contemporary Art
items.shortDescription:
The Indy Art Center announces a Call for Entry to The Eyes are Bigger Than the Stomach, a juried exhibition exploring the conceptual, cultural, and formal inspirations of food in the contemporary art world. This exhibition will examine the theme of food within contemporary art. There are few things so universal and central to the human experience as food. It has shaped cultures, customs, geography, politics and much more across centuries. In 2026, how do we consider food and its impacts through contemporary art? This exhibition will include perspectives from artists using a diverse range of materials and processes.

The Art Center is calling for entries from artists 18 or older working in any media in the United States. Work made with any technique with the subject of food as a critical component are eligible.

items.name: Geneva Arts Fair 2027
items.shortDescription:
Application deadline: February 10, 2027
Geneva Arts Fair is Saturday, July 24 & Sunday, July 25

  • Geneva Arts Fair is in the Top 20 of Fine Art & Design Shows ~ ranked #12 
  • Sunshine Artist 200 Best.  Sunshine Artist’s annual 200 Best focuses solely on artist show revenue
  • Consistently nominated in West Suburban Living’s Best of the West BEST CRAFT OR ART SHOW

It's our 25th year!!! Geneva Arts Fair is an original-only art show with a reputation for quality. The prestigious show offers a superb selection of fine art by renowned artists and cutting edge newcomers from around the country that attracts beginning and avid collectors. Presented by the Geneva Chamber of Commerce, the show is front and center among 100+ specialty shops located in Victorian-style homes and century-old buildings. Geneva, Ill. is a chic and bustling historic town located on the Fox River that offers a picture-postcard setting for this juried art celebration. Its proximity to Chicago and the train line make it a convenient weekend stop. 

In order to maintain the quality of our shows and offer our visitors and buyers a fresh look at new work, we prioritize artists who are new to or unique in the region. We value being a high end show that promotes quality artwork and attracts an enthusiastic crowd.

items.name: "Novum Artis - The New Artistic" Magazine Issue 018
items.shortDescription:
Get Your Art SEEN In Our Boutique-Quality Magazine!

Novum Artis is the magazine for exceptional artists who want to be seen and discovered. Novum Artis is dedicated to exposing new and emerging artists to patrons around the world through online and print-on-demand sources.

Novum Artis is provided to 10,000+ gallery owners/curators, interior designers, real estate stagers, and other decisionmakers in the art and art-adjacent fields worldwide -- the people looking for that next breakthrough artist.

Novum Artis is published without advertising. The centerpiece of each issue is YOUR art. Your presence is boosted with a two page display with your headshot, biography, artist statement, links, and, most important, your original art in high quality. Includes exhibition in our upcoming 3D online virtual art gallery for no additional fee.

View previous issues at http://NovumArtis.com

items.name: Denver Arts Festival 2027
items.shortDescription:
Be a Part of the Highly-Regarded Denver Arts Festival! 
 
All artists are invited to apply!

Now in its 28th year, and 2nd year with new director Jana Novak, the Denver Arts Festival continues to be dedicated to supporting visual art and artists, especially those from Colorado. The Festival's goal is to host an event that champions art and community, resulting in shared success for all participants. 

The Denver Arts Festival consistently ranks as one of the top festivals in the country, and offers high caliber art, supportive community, strong sales opportunities, artist amenities, and a diverse, growing audience eager to connect to art and to community. 

The fine art exhibition features approximately 145 to 150 visual artists with more than 45,000 people expected to attend.

items.name: DEN Arts Rotating Sculpture Program - Spring 2027
items.shortDescription:
Through a competitive selection process artists will loan DEN an existing large-scale sculpture or installation to be temporarily displayed. The sculpture/installation should seek to create a sense of place, elevate the customer experience and create a memorable impression of Denver and the region for travelers and staff.

The mission of DEN Arts is to engage, entertain and educate the public through permanent public artworks, rotating exhibitions and pop-up displays. The Rotating Sculpture Program strives to be a public art incubator for artists in varying stages of their career to gain experience with the complexities of installing and displaying art in a public setting. Through the Rotating Sculpture Program DEN will act as a platform for artists to transition from exhibition and gallery opportunities to securing Public Art commissions.

BUDGET: $10,000

items.name: By Degrees
items.shortDescription:
Same coordinates. Different point of view.

Bitfactory invites artists nationwide to submit work for By Degrees, a juried exhibition open to all media. The exhibition considers subtle shifts in attention and significance—the distances we travel while appearing to remain in place. What once filled the frame may slip beyond its edges; an ordinary moment may become unexpectedly full. Artists are invited to interpret the theme broadly.

items.name: Tombstone
items.shortDescription:
Tombstone: An American Western Adjacent Themed Art Show 

In honor of the Western Stock show, we are having our annual Western Adjacent Themed Group Art Show, "Tombstone". And because this is Memento Mori Gallery, we always invite the outsider, the lowbrow, and the macabre.

Emerging and established artists are encouraged to apply.

Memento Mori Gallery & Tattoo is a lowbrow contemporary art gallery & private tattoo studio located in the 40West Arts District in Lakewood, Colorado, just 15 minutes from downtown Denver. We are in the same shopping center as Casa Bonita.

items.name: The Last Supper - The Last Casa Bonita Art Show
items.shortDescription:
ALL ART MUST DIRECTLY RELATE TO THE CASA BONITA RESTAURANT IN LAKEWOOD, COLORADO!

Casa Bonita is the restaurant with an 85 foot tall pink stucco tower, featuring a 30-foot indoor waterfall, cliff divers, mariachi music, puppet shows, a haunted cave and much, much, more.

Please join us in celebrating the 10th Annual Casa Bonita Art Show. Let's convene for The Last Supper!

In addition to visual art, we are accepting literary art fitting the theme of The Last Supper.

items.name: 2027 Benson Sculpture in the Park Show & Sale
items.shortDescription:
Join us for the 2027 annual Sculpture in the Park Show and Sale August 13th, 14th, 15th, 2027 Celebrating 43 Years!

The Sculpture in the Park Show and Sale is heralded as one of the finest outdoor juried exhibitions of contemporary, three-dimensional artwork in the United States. This exhibition hosts 168 of the most talented sculptors from around the world and is known for featuring a wide and diverse range of artistic expressions.  The show and Sale held at Loveland’s nationally acclaimed Benson Sculpture Garden and is presented by the Loveland High Plains Art Council.

items.name: Keyhole
items.shortDescription:
"Keyhole"

A Group Exhibition Exploring What Lies Beyond

A keyhole is a threshold. It offers a glimpse of something hidden, a passage into somewhere unknown, or a view into a story that has yet to unfold.

We invite artists to submit work for “Keyhole,” a group exhibition exploring the many meanings of the keyhole—literal, symbolic, psychological, mysterious, intimate, or surreal.

Emerging and established artists are encouraged to apply.

Memento Mori Gallery & Tattoo is a lowbrow contemporary art gallery & private tattoo studio located in the 40West Arts District in Lakewood, Colorado, just 15 minutes from downtown Denver. We are in the same shopping center as Casa Bonita.

items.name: 61st CAIN National
items.shortDescription:
ABOUT THE SHOW
$10,000 in PURCHASE AWARDS

The CAIN National Show attracts works by contemporary artists nationwide and is judged by a guest juror of national stature. Resulting Purchase Awards have built an impressive Permanent Collection at Del Mar College.

This year's 61st show runs February 19, 2027, with an opening reception from 6-8 p.m. and closes April 19, 2026. Accepted artwork is displayed in the distinctive Joseph A. Cain Memorial Gallery.

items.name: Carroll Harris Simms National Black Art Competition and Exhibition
items.shortDescription: The Carroll Harris Simms National Black Art Competition, the 29th biennial event, is a prestigious platform for showcasing excellence in Black artistry. Artists compete across categories such as painting, drawing, printmaking, photography, and mixed media; category winners receive recognition and awards, and their works become part of the museum's permanent collection. This tradition not only preserves but also celebrates Black artists' creative achievements and contributions to culture for generations to come.

items.name: 42nd Annual International Exhibition
items.shortDescription:
CONTACT 

Madison Branch, Gallery and Community Outreach and Education Coordinator

Email:  mbranch@uttyler.edu

Phone:  903-566-7237

 

DESCRIPTION The 42nd Annual International Exhibition is a juried visual art competition organized by the Department of Art and Art History at The University of Texas at Tyler and displayed at the university’s Meadows Gallery. Internationally known artists, curators, and scholars have served as jurors selecting works for exhibition created by some of the best contemporary artists working today. The department purchases three to six works from the exhibition each year; purchased works are added to our permanent collection. The permanent collection serves as an educational teaching resource; much of the permanent collection is exhibited throughout the UT Tyler main campus.

items.name: Nude Nite 2027 Tampa Bay
items.shortDescription:
For over two decades, Nude Nite has challenged the traditional gallery experience, transforming unexpected spaces into immersive, multi-sensory exhibitions celebrating the human form.

More than an art show, Nude Nite exists at the intersection of art, performance, and human connection. Each exhibition brings together over 200 works of figurative art alongside large-scale installations, live performances, and interactive experiences that invite audiences to explore vulnerability, individuality, and the beauty of being human.

Nude Nite welcomes artists working across mediums and disciplines to be part of our 2027 Tampa Bay exhibition.

Exhibition Dates: Late February – Early March 2027 (exact dates to be announced)
Location: Tampa Bay, Florida (Tampa or St. Petersburg; venue to be announced)

Website: www.nudenite.com
Instagram: @nudenite
TikTok: @nnexperience
Facebook: @nudenite

items.name: North American Watercolor Membership Exhibition 2027
items.shortDescription:
Open to current North American Watercolor members, the 2027 NAW Members Exhibition celebrates outstanding work in watercolor and water-based media. Artists may submit up to three works for consideration.

Awards include $1,000 Best of Show, $300 Second Place, $200 Third Place, $300 People’s Choice, plus Honorable Mention merchandise awards. Estimated $4,000 in cash and prizes.

Not a member yet? Artists may join NAW before entering the exhibition.

items.name: 41st Annual All-Florida Exhibition
items.shortDescription: This annual show is the most anticipated of the year. As the name suggests, this exhibition features pieces created by artists working in a wide variety of media from all over the 65,000 square miles that make up Florida. The juried entries come together for an award-winning and exciting exhibition representing today’s contemporary Florida artists. The exhibition will be on display at the Alliance for the Arts in Fort Myers from March 5 – 27, 2027.

items.name: 27th Florida Outdoor Sculpture Competition
items.shortDescription:
The City of Lakeland, Florida, in cooperation with the Polk Museum of Art, is accepting submissions from sculptors for the 27th Annual Florida Outdoor Sculpture Competition. Submitted sculptures will be juried by representatives from the City, the Polk Museum of Art, and members of the local art community. The top-scoring sculptures will be selected for a one-year exhibition in downtown Lakeland, Florida, with a $1,700 honorarium. Sculptures will be on loan from February 2027 through January 2028. Sculptures will be publicized, and a People’s Choice Award ($1,700) will be awarded based on community voting.

This call for entries is open to all sculptors working in North America.
Entries must be submitted through the online call process by January 3, 2027. The link to the Call can be found at Lakelandgov.net/FLOSC.
Submissions require a $25 non-refundable application fee per artist.
Each artist selected for the exhibition will receive a $1,700 honorarium

items.name: Nude Nite 2027 Orlando
items.shortDescription:
For over two decades, Nude Nite has challenged the traditional gallery experience, transforming unexpected spaces into immersive, multi-sensory exhibitions celebrating the human form.

More than an art show, Nude Nite exists at the intersection of art, performance, and human connection. Each exhibition brings together over 200 works of figurative art alongside large-scale installations, live performances, and interactive experiences that invite audiences to explore vulnerability, individuality, and the beauty of being human.

Nude Nite welcomes artists working across mediums and disciplines to be part of our 2027 Orlando exhibition.

Exhibition Dates: Early February 2027 (exact dates and venue to be announced)
Location: Orlando, Florida

Website: www.nudenite.com
Instagram: @nudenite
TikTok: @nnexperience
Facebook: @nudenite

items.name: Then and Now: A Legacy Exhibition
items.shortDescription:
As Artists of Palm Beach County marks its 20th anniversary, we invite artists to look back at where their creative journeys began - and celebrate where those journeys have taken them.

Then & Now is an exhibition about artistic growth, discovery, and transformation. Participating artists will present two related works: an earlier piece representing “Then” and a more recent piece representing “Now.” The “Then” piece will be printed on 8 x 10 paper and will be hung near the new work.

items.name: Fridge Art Fair Miami 2026: Open Call for Artists
items.shortDescription: Fridge is the small but mighty art show that happens every year in New York and Miami. This December, Fridge returns for Miami Art Week, December 1 to 6, 2026, in several venues in and around South Beach. Each application is for one work, and it costs $35 to apply. Apply as many times as you like. Everyone is welcome.

items.name: Plains Conservation Center - Prairie Meander - Aurora, CO
items.shortDescription:
THE PROJECT

The City of Aurora, Colorado Art in Public Places Program seeks qualifications from Indigenous artists for the fourth of five public art commissions planned for the Plains Conservation Center. This opportunity calls for a three-dimensional artwork for the Prairie Meander project that will explore the connections between people, land, ecology, history, and movement through the prairie landscape. The selected artwork will be integrated into the Plains Conservation Center site, creating an opportunity for a meaningful sculptural experience that engages visitors as they move through and explore the landscape.

items.name: THE BIG BITE: A Call for Artists Who Go For It
items.shortDescription:
Some artists nibble around the edges. Others take a big, unapologetic bite.

The Lab on Santa Fe is calling on artists who aren’t afraid to sink their teeth into something strange, beautiful, excessive, uncomfortable, hilarious, or downright impossible to ignore.

What does it mean to go for it? Is it a matter of scale? Appetite? An outrageous idea executed with extraordinary precision? Or something so small and peculiar that it somehow swallows the room?

We’re interested in work that takes risks, challenges expectations, and refuses to play it safe. All styles, subjects, and mediums are welcome. The Big Bite isn’t about what you make. It’s about the hunger behind it.

Show us what happens when you bite off more than you can chew.

Located in Denver’s Art District on Santa Fe, The Lab on Santa Fe offers tremendous visibility through First Friday Art Walks that are the largest in the state along with high likelihood of sales and collector interest.

items.name: Juno Beach Craft Festival on the Ocean Juno Beach, FL: 24th Annual November 2026 ACE
items.shortDescription: This craft show is one of the most eagerly awaited events of the year in Palm Beach. Located along the picturesque A1A, with the sound of waves crashing nearby and refreshing sea breezes in the air, this event is truly unmissable! The show is closed. All applications will be juried for wait list only.

items.name: Mosaic Arts International 2027
items.shortDescription: The Society of American Mosaic Artists (SAMA) invites artists working in mosaic media to submit applications to Mosaic Arts International (MAI) 2027: Fine Art & Site-Specific Mosaic.  Held in conjunction with SAMA's annual conference, the juried exhibit showcases the best contemporary fine art mosaics from SAMA's diverse international membership. Fine Art is a segment of the Mosaic Arts International 2027 exhibition series that will be presented at Museum of Biblical Art (Fine Art Segment): February 17 – August 22, 2027, and the Irving Art Center (Site-Specific and Architectural Segment): February 6- March 27, 2027.

items.name: THE LANDSCAPE: SERENE AND SAVAGE
items.shortDescription:
"THE LANDSCAPE: SERENE AND SAVAGE" AT MVA GALLERY

NATIONAL CALL FOR ENTRIES 

Nature can be tranquil and comforting -- beautiful gardens, picturesque seacoasts, glowing sunsets and sunrises, gentle rain showers, mighty trees and graceful clouds. On the other hand, Nature can be ferocious and dangerous -- raging thunderstorms, jagged mountain cliffs, uncontrollable floods, earthquake carnage and hostile wilderness.    

Please show us your interpretations and visions of Landscape. They can be serene or savage, intimate or vast, somber or bright, mysterious or lucid, realistic or imaginary. People, animals and architectural structures can be included. All styles and techniques are welcome.  

Please join us and show off your talent!

items.name: GOING GREEN
items.shortDescription:
"GOING GREEN'' AT MVA GALLERY  --  MODERN VISUAL ARTS  

NATIONAL CALL FOR ENTRIES:        

Green is located in the center of the color spectrum as if to proclaim its significance as the center of the color universe!

The color Green is traditionally associated with nature -- especially Spring -- and, therefore, has come  to signify renewal, growth and abundance. Some cultures believe that Green symbolizes vitality, harmony and balance. 

In Hinduism and Buddhism, the heart chakra ("energy center" in the body) is Green and represents compassion and empathy.  

As an artist, how do you utilize Green? Does the color permeate your entire image or is it used in small sections? Does it appear in your artwork in objects or in nature or in portrait studies or in abstract design? How does color reveal your technical skill and emotional impact?

No restrictions on subject matter or style. All approaches are acceptable -- traditional or experimental, representational or abstract. Please join us!

 

.....

items.name: ART WEIRD AND WILD
items.shortDescription:
"ART WEIRD AND WILD'' EXHIBIT AT MVA GALLERY  --  MODERN VISUAL ARTS  

NATIONAL CALL FOR ENTRIES:     If your art is strange or unconventional, this is the exhibition for you. Please share your weird and wild images with us.

Art historians have praised the avant-garde artists who were grouped into movements such as Surrealism, Dadaism, Expressionism, and Magic Realism.

Many of you may share their bold stylistic approaches and imaginative exploration of themes. These include (but are not limited to): Dreams, nightmares and the unconscious; enigmatic landscapes; mysterious and supernatural scenes; bizarre creatures; eerie light and shadow; distortion and fragmentation; unexpected color combinations; narratives of alienation and anger; warped perspective; surprising juxtaposition of objects; metamorphosis of people, animals and objects; and anything else -- ordinary or eccentric -- that excites you.

You have limitless creative freedom. Please join us for this adventure!

 

 

.......

...

........

items.name: GRANDEUR OF COLOR
items.shortDescription:
"GRANDEUR OF COLOR'' EXHIBIT AT MVA GALLERY  --  MODERN VISUAL ARTS  

NATIONAL CALL FOR ENTRIES:        

Color is everywhere and it has a powerful influence on human perceptions, emotions and behavior. Artists use of color is very personal -- whether intellectual or intuitive, purposeful or accidental, traditional or experimental.

People have preconceived ideas of the relationship of colors to specific objects. Some artists beautifully depict this perceived reality. Other artists inhabit a subjective universe where color is relative. They can creatively transfer shapes and transform objects to reconstruct reality through the grandeur of color.

We invite you to show us your personal visions. They can be realistic or imaginary, representational or abstract. This is an OPEN CALL with no restrictions on subject matter or style. Anything goes, so let's celebrate Color!

 

 

............

......

items.name: ART OF THE STILL LIFE
items.shortDescription:
"ART OF THE STILL LIFE'' EXHIBIT AT MVA GALLERY  --  MODERN VISUAL ARTS  

NATIONAL CALL FOR ENTRIES:        

Still life art is much admired today. It portrays mostly inanimate subject matter -- natural or man-made objects. These images of everyday items that surround us can appeal to our visual sense by a traditional or innovative presentation.

During past centuries, artists favored flowers, fruits, plants, vases, books, candles, shells, mirrors, plates, and musical instruments. They were frequently imbued with symbolic or moralistic meaning.

But your artistic eye can select anything no matter how mundane -- pot, toaster, clock, phone, computer, lamp, clothing, jewelry and toys. You can present them in their natural state or, through artistic manipulation, you can debase or elevate them.

You have limitless freedom as we welcome all styles and techniques. Present a straightforward image or explore creative possibilities. We enthusiastically look forward to seeing your artwork.

.......

.....

items.name: The Art Advocacy Project 2D (TAAP 2D)
items.shortDescription: The City of Loveland Art in Public Places program seeks artists for The Art Advocacy Project 2D (commonly known as TAAP 2D) in the Loveland Public Library’s Central Galleria. This popular public art exhibit is a one-year on-loan program designed to promote regional artists through the public display of their artworks. This project is open to all Colorado artists of two-dimensional media. Artists will be compensated with an honorarium of $350.00. Colorado artists working in two-dimensional media are encouraged to apply to this annual exhibition. This project is open to artists (18 years or older) at any stage of their career.

items.name: Walkable Future: Art in Motion!
items.shortDescription:
Denver Arts & Venues seeks an artist or artist team to create permanent public artwork for Inspiration Point Park in the Regis neighborhood and Martin Luther King Jr. Recreation Center in Central Park, Denver, Colorado. The project celebrates community values, histories, cultures, people, and intergenerational connections. One artist or team will be selected for a total budget of approximately $21,500.

A virtual pre-application meeting will take place Monday, November 23, 2026, at 5:30 p.m. MT via Zoom. The session will cover project goals, the RFQ application process, the Walkable Futures: Art in Motion opportunity. Interested applicants are asked to register to receive information on how to join prior to the event. If you cannot attend, a recording will be available on the Denver Arts & Venues YouTube channel.

items.name: 2027 Sculpture in the Square - Fort Collins
items.shortDescription: Old Town Square is the heart of Fort Collins. We are looking for six sculptures that are resilient and durable for our year-round sculpture-on-loan exhibit. Each artist will receive a $1,500 honorarium. We will award a $1,000 People's Choice Award in the fall of 2027. Installation will occur on Saturday, April 24, 2027, and remain for one year.

items.name: Sculpture Showcase 2027-2028
items.shortDescription: Center for the Arts Evergreen (CAE) invites artists to submit sculptures to its 28th annual rotating Sculpture Showcase of public art in Evergreen, Colorado, located in the foothills west of Denver. This is a juried exhibition of up to 16 large sculptures. Sculptures must be suitable for OUTDOOR INSTALLATION and must stand at a minimum of 4' tall. Sculptures should be designed and fabricated to withstand wind gusts of up to 100 mph, which are common in Evergreen. Due to the nature of our sites, many require larger sculptures, and pieces standing between 4 to 12 feet in height have the best chance of being chosen. Artists may submit up to 3 sculptures for consideration. Sculptures will be on display for 1 year from June 5, 2027, until June 2, 2028. The sculptures will be listed as available for purchase in a published brochure and on our website. Artists must be present (or send a representative) for installation on Saturday, June 5, 2027, and deinstallation on Friday, June 2, 2028....

items.name: Hiawatha Davis Recreation Center Public Art Opportunity!
items.shortDescription:
Denver Arts and Venues seeks to commission an artist or artist team to create a permanent public artwork in Northeast Park Hill, Denver, Colorado. The project seeks artwork that reflects and celebrates Northeast Park Hill's unique character and the people, histories, cultures, and experiences that have shaped the neighborhood across generations.  Northeast Park Hill is a community with a rich history, representing a culturally diverse neighborhood with strong relationships, deep-rooted pride, creativity, and fortitude. The selected artwork should contribute to a meaningful sense of place and should come from an understanding of the community rather than impose an outside narrative on it.

Denver Public Art is hosting a virtual pre-application meeting for interested applicants on Monday, November 23, 2026 at 5:30 p.m. MT. Attendees will receive information on CallForEntry.org through which artists may apply. This event will be hosted on Zoom. Interested applicants are asked to registe...

items.name: South Suburban 2027 Art On Loan
items.shortDescription:
The 2027 Art on Loan Program administered by the South Suburban Public Art Committee (SSPAC), a committee appointed by the South Suburban Park and Recreation District (SSPRD) Board of Directors, is accepting proposals to exhibit the sculptural artwork of artists that have at any time resided in the State of Colorado for a 1-year period. The program is a year-long outdoor exhibit designed to promote public interest in art, develop community pride, and enhance the visitor experience around the Goodson Recreation Center (Centennial), Bega Park (Littleton), and The Hudson Gardens & Events Center (Littleton). Additional information about SSPRD and SSPAC can be accessed at ssprd.org and about The Hudson Gardens hudsongardens.org SUBMITTAL DEADLINE:    Monday, January 11th, 2027 at 11:59 pm Mountain Time
Selected art will be awarded $1,000 Exhibitor’s Honorarium to each artist after the artwork is installed in May 14th 2027.  (If an artist is late installing their work the honorarium will b...

items.name: City of Loveland, CO - The Art Advocacy Project (TAAP 3D) 2027-2029
items.shortDescription: The City of Loveland Art in Public Places Program seeks outdoor sculpture for a two-year, on-loan program in Downtown Loveland as part of The Art Advocacy Project (TAAP). This call is open to all artists of three-dimensional outdoor media and is scheduled from June 2027 to late May 2029. Selected artists will be awarded an honorarium of $2,000 each year (for a total of $4,000). The installed artwork may be available for sale.

items.name: Plains Conservation Center - Prairie Wetland Laboratory - Aurora, CO
items.shortDescription:
THE PROJECT

The City of Aurora, CO is seeking a sculpture for the Prairie Wetlands Laboratory, the fifth and final of five public art commissions by Indigenous artists at the Plains Conservation Center. Artists and artist teams are welcome to apply. The selected artwork should invite visitors to engage with the prairie wetland landscape and reflect on the relationships between water, land, wildlife, and people.

The Prairie Wetlands Laboratory will be an outdoor classroom on the northeastern edge of the 1,100-acre shortgrass prairie preserve, with a gathering space, shade shelters, and a bird blind for school and community programs, wildlife viewing, and citizen science. Wetlands at the site provide vital habitat for birds, amphibians, and other wildlife within the dry prairie. Artists may explore ideas of water, observation, seasonal change, migration, renewal, reciprocity, and stewardship through their own cultural knowledge and artistic practice.

items.name: 20th Anniversary-Joyce Elaine Grant (JEG) Juried Art Exhibition
items.shortDescription:
Established in 2001, Texas Woman’s University (TWU) and the Photographic Artists’ Coalition (P.A.C., a student-run photography organization), the biennial Joyce Elaine Grant (JEG) Photography Exhibition provides a national venue for the exhibition of artistic expression as seen through the eye of the camera.

Biennially, a distinguished female curator serves as juror and selects images submitted by photographers throughout the United States. The exhibition is on view to the public at the TWU's East | West Galleries every other spring. The juror also awards one artist a solo exhibition, scheduled during the following JEG Exhibition.

The exhibition and endowment were established by alumna Christine Shank and a small group of graduate students, named in memory of the mother of Professor Susan kae Grant. Exhibition proceeds fund the Joyce Elaine Grant Photography Exhibition Endowment, which supports photography scholarships for future graduate students in the Division of Visual Arts.

items.name: WOMAN - 2027 (7th Juried Annual Exhibition, Promotion, Sales)
items.shortDescription:

This 7th juried annual international exhibition, promotion, and sales opportunity invites artists worldwide to share visual stories that honor women’s achievements, amplify their voices, and raise awareness of the challenges they face.

items.name: LOVE - 2027 (7th Juried Annual Exhibition, Promotion, Sales)
items.shortDescription:
LOVE 2027: The Art of Connection

Love connects, heals, and transforms us—it is the essence of being human. Exhibizone invites artists worldwide to explore the boundless expressions of love through art in LOVE 2027, the 7th annual international juried exhibition, promotion, and sales. From romance and friendship to compassion, self-acceptance, and love for nature, this opportunity celebrates every shade of love—pure, complicated, eternal, or lost.

All 2D and 3D mediums and styles are welcome. Selected artists will showcase their work in Exhibizone’s global online exhibition, on Artsy.net, and in a beautifully designed exhibition catalog.

Submission is free; a small fee applies to jury-selected artists only. 

LOVE 2027 offers a meaningful platform where your art can move hearts, inspire reflection, and unite people to become part of a powerful tradition that resonates across borders and cultures.

Explore last year’s exhibition at https://www.exhibizone.com/love2026

items.name: Civic Campus Plaza Artwork
items.shortDescription:
The City of Greeley invites qualifications from professional artists and artist teams to create a permanent, site-responsive public art gathering space for the new Downtown Civic Campus.

items.name: Coconut Point Holiday Craft Festival December 2026 (Estero, FL) American Craft Endeavors
items.shortDescription:

It features a car show, live music, a parade, and a tree lighting ceremony, attracting more than 4,000 attendees. Show hours are from 10 AM to 6 PM on Saturday, with option to stay open later, and from 11 AM to 6 PM on Sunday. Booths will be arranged along the sidewalks adjacent to the storefronts. items.name: Salon Series I
items.shortDescription:
Art Scene West invites artists to submit work for The Salon Series, a curated juried exhibition series presented in San Diego, California.

Inspired by the tradition of the historic Paris Salon, The Salon Series is an ongoing exhibition program created to bring together compelling artists and exceptional works of art in a professional gallery setting. Each exhibition is thoughtfully juried and curated, with selected artists given the opportunity to exhibit their work at Art Scene West, a contemporary art gallery in San Diego’s Seaport Village.

The Salon Series embraces the diversity of contemporary art. Artists working in painting, drawing, photography, sculpture, mixed media, digital art, printmaking, illustration, and other visual mediums are encouraged to submit. Work may range from representational to abstract, traditional to experimental, provided it demonstrates a strong artistic point of view and contributes to the character of the exhibition.

items.name: In The Abstract - VIRTUAL EXHIBITION
items.shortDescription:
In the Abstract a VIRTUAL EXHIBITION. SFVACC invites artists to enter our annual juried exhibition, In The Abstract a Virtual Exhibition. Abstract art uses shapes, forms, color, line and texture as opposed to representing an accurate depiction of visual reality. Abstract art challenges artists to explore new ways of seeing and expressing themselves. 

Implicit to abstract art is the notion that the work of art exists in its own right, and not necessarily as a mirror of reality. -The Concise Oxford Dictionary of Art Terms

items.name: Works on Paper
items.shortDescription:
Paper Route: Contemporary Works on Paper
April 3 – May 16, 2027
Margot Yale, Juror

Paper Route: Contemporary Works on Paper explores the profound, quiet power of art's most enduring foundation. Often relegated to a supporting role or viewed as a mere testing ground for larger concepts, paper is reexamined here as an active, vital collaborator. 

This exhibition brings together a diverse array of artistic disciplines, from the fluid immediacy of watercolor and the stark precision of ink, to the layered textures of mixed media and printmaking. Unified by a single material constraint, these works reveal how the unique tooth, fiber, and weight of the paper substrate dictate the behavior of different mediums and highlight the diversity of routes artists take in their use of paper. 

All 2D and 3D media accepted where the substrate is paper. 2D work may not exceed 36”W or 72”H, including the frame. 3D work may not exceed a 36” x 36” footprint. 

Deadline:  January 12, 2027 (11:59 pm Pacific Time)...

items.name: Creative Minds - 2026 (4th Annual Juried Exhibition, Promotion, Sales)
items.shortDescription:
Creative Minds 2026: Where Imagination Takes Form

Exhibizone proudly presents the 4th annual Creative Minds 2026—an international juried smart exhibition that invites visual artists around the world to step forward and reveal what imagination looks like through their unique artistic vision.

items.name: Curves - 2027 (4th Annual Juried Exhibition, Promotion, Sales)
items.shortDescription:
Bend a curve in visitors' minds 

Exhibizone delightfully presents Curves 2027, the 4th annual juried art exhibition to celebrate the beauty and versatility of curves in art. 

Curves are those wavy bends, spirals, circles, swirls, or S-shaped lines that change direction gradually and can convey energy with a sense of movement and fluidity to create a gentle feeling of beauty, ease, and comfort. They also illustrate the fluid movement of water and communicate a sensual sense as they remind us of the human body. 

For Curves 2027, the subject is free, and we encourage artists to explore the diverse interpretations of curves. Whether you choose to depict organic curves found in nature, artificial ones made by humans, abstract curves that evoke emotions, or the elegant curves of the human body.

All abstract and representational art in any medium is welcome.

The submission is free, and a small fee applies to selected artists only.

Last year's exhibition at: https://www.exhibizone.com/curves202...

items.name: Look at me - 2027 (3rd Annual Juried Exhibition, Promotion, Sales)
items.shortDescription:
Show your world, share your emotions, and inspire visitors with your visual stories

Exhibizone proudly presents Look At Me 2027, the 3rd annual juried exhibition to celebrate the power of self-expression.

Your creativity knows no bounds, and we encourage you to push the boundaries of your chosen medium to create compelling and thought-provoking artworks.

items.name: Still There - 2026 (Juried Annual Exhibition, Promotion, Sales)
items.shortDescription:
Still There 2026: Still Life Redefined

Discovering Extraordinary Visual Stories in Ordinary Things

Exhibizone proudly presents Still There 2026, an international juried exhibition, promotion, and sales opportunity celebrating still life, observation, and the remarkable stories hidden within ordinary subjects.

We often move through life without noticing the quiet beauty surrounding us. The seemingly simple objects and moments that often hold memories, emotions, anticipation, and meaning far beyond what first meets the eye.

Through art, they become more than everyday scenes.

Still There 2026 invites artists from around the world to explore the beauty, narrative, symbolism, and visual power of still life and quiet moments through contemporary and traditional artistic expression. Whether realistic or abstract, classical or experimental, your work can reveal the extraordinary hidden within the familiar.

items.name: PORTALS, PASSAGES, AND BEYOND
items.shortDescription:
"PORTALS, PASSAGES, AND BEYOND'' EXHIBIT AT MVA GALLERY

National Call For Entries:     Portals -- including doors, entranceways and windows --  function as physical and psychological points of arrival and departure. Doors may be admired for architectural features, but they also can be symbolic. Windows reveal atmospheric views, but they can be rich with factual or metaphorical meaning. 

Portals and passages are also associated with corridors, streets, tunnels and bridges. They can serve as symbolic entrances into other realms, real or imaginary. What is beyond? They can present the concept of crossing over to a mysterious or spiritual experience. Or to a macabre or happy reality or dream world.

All these themes and subthemes are appropriate for your artwork for this exhibition. Whether you wish to submit a straightforward image of a portal or passageway, or whether you wish to offer an image layered with symbolic associations, we are excited to see your art.

items.name: Richmond Arts in the Park 2027
items.shortDescription:
The 56th annual Arts in the Park (AIP) show, held annually on the first weekend in May, takes place May 1-2, 2027 at The Carillon in beautiful Byrd Park in Richmond, VA. Our goal is to provide a venue for creators of fine art and fine craft to connect with the art-buying public.

Hosted by the Carillon Civic Association (CCA) and residents of the Carillon neighborhood, AIP continues to be community-run and inclusion-focused, staffed by volunteers from the neighborhood and drawing large local crowds and artists from across the country; in 2026 we had almost 400 artists from 25 states and Canada exhibit. We estimate the show drew 80K attendees over the two days.

Arts in the Park is a Richmond tradition, and we advertise the show on our social media, website, ZAPP, and local media.

Our community comes together to put on AIP, and we try our best to create a friendly, open atmosphere and provide excellent artist hospitality throughout the weekend, with coffee and light refreshments provided each morning of the show.

Always free to the public, Richmond Arts in the Park draws strong community support. More than just an art show, it’s about fostering community spirit and reconnecting with friends.

items.name: Contradiction
items.shortDescription:

Contradiction is not a problem to solve. The most resonant work often comes from the space between opposing forces such as tenderness in strength, clarity in noise, order in disorder.

With its relaxed, friendly atmosphere and serious potential shoppers, this show has become a favorite of professional artists.

items.name: St. Armands Circle Art Festival 37th Annual (Sarasota, FL) Howard Alan Events November 2026
items.shortDescription: Situated in this tropical haven, the St. Armands Circle Art Festival draws in thousands of art enthusiasts eager to acquire exquisite and distinctive pieces. The combination of the vibrant community and the picturesque setting contributes to the festival's ongoing success each year.

items.name: Ali Cultural Center Sculpture 2027
items.shortDescription:
BUDGET:           $45,000.00

DEADLINE:       November 12, 2026

OVERVIEW

The City will commission an artist/artist team for a work for hire project to design, fabricate, and install a sculpture to be placed at the north entrance of the Ali Cultural Center. The sculpture’s theme is “Rooted Pride, Living Legacy.” The artwork should honor the Black community of Pompano Beach’s Northwest—its culture, history, pride, style, creativity, and resilience—acknowledging struggle while celebrating a future in motion and a legacy that never gives up.

items.name: Englewood Invitational Winter Art Festival 2027
items.shortDescription: Thousands of art lovers have flocked to the Englewood Invitational Winter Art Festival for over 39 years to shop for unique handmade fine arts and fine crafts.  Artist Run and Artist Friendly, the Englewood Invitational is in the wealthy Englewood/Boca Grande community which is growing daily with sophisticated new homeowners and art buyers looking to add new work to their art collections and decorate their new homes.  The fabulous location on the spacious grounds of a private club in downtown Englewood has great visibility and traffic, lots of room, onsite parking for artists and patrons, easy load and unload and back of booth art storage.  The quality of our 100 exhibitors and extensive regional marketing makes our show a fun and profitable event for everyone.

items.name: Kierland Fine Art & Wine Winter Festival - 2027
items.shortDescription:
The award winning Kierland Fine Art & Wine Festival, hosted in the prestigious Kierland Commons enclave, stands as a premier event blending art, wine, and a vibrant cultural experience. Organized by Vermillion Promotions, with over 30 years of event management expertise, this festival is renowned for its commitment to artists and delivering exceptional visitor experiences.

This exclusive festival invites 150 premier artists to showcase their work amidst the upscale surroundings of Kierland Commons. Patrons can indulge in wine tastings from regional wineries, savor gourmet delights from sidewalk cafes and food stations, enjoy live music, and participate in interactive art activities. Kierland Commons itself is a sophisticated outdoor lifestyle center, artfully blending shopping, dining, and entertainment.

Located at the crossroads of North Scottsdale and Phoenix, Kierland Commons is a hub for cultural and lifestyle events, drawing affluent patrons from nearby prestigious events such as the Barrett-Jackson Classic Car Auction, the Waste Management Open, and the Scottsdale Bentley Polo Championships. This strategic location enhances the festival's appeal, making it a must-attend destination for art enthusiasts and collectors alike.

items.name: Showcase 2027 Proposal
items.shortDescription:
The Showcase 2027  program features local and regional artists in Northwind Art’s Jeanette Best Gallery, 701 Water Street, Port Townsend. During the year, the program will gather approximately 36 artists in three cohorts, each of which will show across three separate periods:  January 28 - May 10, May 13 - September 6, and September 9 - January 3, 2028.

The application period will close on November 12, 2026. All artists will be notified by December 5, 2026 with an acceptance or denial letter sent to the email associated with their CaFE account. 

The application fee is waived for members of the historically underrepresented BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ communities. We offer this waiver on the honor system. To apply fee free, use the code DISCOUNT at checkout.

items.name: SOMI Art Fest 2027
items.shortDescription:
42nd Annual
SOMI Art Fest

The Weekend After Presidents' Day
February 20 & 21, 2027 The 42nd annual SOMI Art Fest is a juried two day outdoor festival that takes place on Sunset Drive in the vibrant downtown area of South Miami from US1 to Red Road (57th Avenue).


The area is filled with historic buildings, restaurants and unique shops. Just 3 miles south of Miami's Coconut Grove, South Miami borders the University of Miami and the upscale neighborhoods of Coral Gables and Pinecrest.

items.name: Cocoa Village Art & Craft Holiday Bazaar 2026
items.shortDescription:
The Cocoa Village Art & Craft Fairs are one of Florida's largest and well-established makers markets.  For the past 40+ years, 4 times a year, over 250 artists and crafters line the streets of our historic downtown and the beautiful waterfront park along the Indian River Lagoon.

We pride ourselves on the quality and diversity of attending artisans, creating a venue where anyone from fine artists to emerging crafters can connect with the 40,000+ visitors from our vibrant community.

The first fair of the year developed into the "Spring Fine Art & Craft Fair" with a more in-depth jurying process, a fine art competition, and thousands of dollars of prize money.  The last fair of the year transformed into the "Art & Craft Holiday Bazaar", inviting the local businesses of our downtown to set up booths at this holiday-shopping-oriented event.

We are continually working to improve the artist and crafter experience, attendee experience, and the impact on our local economy.

items.name: Naples Artcrafters November / December 2026 Show (Fine Artist and Fine Artcrafters)
items.shortDescription:
This application is for NOV 14  and DEC 12. If you wish to apply to only one of the two shows, contact us. 
Intrested in donating to Naples Art Crafters? Click here
If artist is accepted, upon receiving acceptance they will be required to purchase the booth fee at the Naples Artcrafters store.

Naples Artcrafters is a show that specializes in fine art. In bussiness for over 65 years, our show season runs from November through April. Our monthly shows are free to the public and are held on Saturdays in Cambier Park in downtown Naples.

Show hours are 10 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. 

Cambier Park is one block south of Fifth Avenue in downtown Naples and is in walking distance to many fine restaurants, boutiques, and galleries. Parking for the Cambier Park shows is free and available in the public parking garage adjacent to the park in downtown Naples.

items.name: Holiday Bazaar 2026 at Russell Crossroads
items.shortDescription: Thank you for your interest in being apart of our Holiday Bazaar! This event is held to kick off the holiday season and to promote and support the amazing pieces of work the talented artists in the Southeast area and our community have created. Holiday Bazaar is held in conjunction with Christmas at Crossroads, a community event to spread the holiday cheer and bring Santa to town! We are looking forward to another thrilling event at Russell Crossroads.

items.name: The Harding Art Show 2027
items.shortDescription:
Since 1975, The Harding Art Show has grown into one of the largest and most successful fine art exhibitions in the Southeastern U.S. From April 29–May 1, 2027, Harding Academy will proudly host the 52nd Annual Harding Art Show on our Nashville campus. With help from dedicated volunteers, we transform our PreK–8th grade school into a vibrant venue where artists display their work in both indoor and outdoor spaces.

We will feature approximately 90 artists and welcome around 5,000 guests—including art collectors, interior designers, and enthusiasts from the Greater Nashville community. Proceeds benefit Harding Academy’s student programs, facilities, and arts education.

The 2027 show will be held in person, with an option for artists to offer limited online exclusives, extending the show’s reach through our digital platform. We promote the show across multiple channels, giving artists exceptional visibility. The in-person format allows for direct engagement with attendees, creating lasting connections—a highlight for both artists and guests.

Our volunteers strive to make the artist experience as easy and enjoyable as possible. Volunteers serve as liaisons to support artists in the months leading up to the show, welcome artists on campus for set-up by helping them unload their art, and are available throughout the show to troubleshoot issues.

The Harding Art Show 2026 show was a record-breaking success, generating $1.7 million in art sales.

items.name: City of Newport South Beach HWY 101 Gateway Sculptures
items.shortDescription: Oregon Coast Council for the Arts (“OCCA”) is seeking an artist, or artist team to commission two, large-scale, public art sculptures for the City of Newport. These two Gateway pieces will be on HWY 101 and are part of the South Beach Placemaking Project. Budget is $100,000 per sculpture. Artists may submit for one or both sculptures. This opportunity is open to artists with public art sculpture experience, with preference for those located in the Pacific Northwest.

items.name: Bladensburg Bus Garage Public Art Project
items.shortDescription:
The WMATA Art in Transit Program is inviting professional Artists/Artist-led Teams to submit their qualifications to create a site-specific artwork as part of the Phase 2 of the Bladensburg Bus Garage Reconstruction Project. The three-dimensional artwork, such as a sculpture or a functional artwork, will be located by the Bus Entrance along Bladensburg Rd NE near 28th Street NE, and will serve as a welcoming landmark. The total public art budget is $330,000. Submissions are due November 15, 2026.

Responses to Vendor Clarification Questions are posted at the end of Part 7.

items.name: 14th Biennial Alexander Rutsch Award and Exhibition for Painting 2027
items.shortDescription:
Biennial Competition - 2027 Alexander Rutsch Award and Exhibition for Painting

Prize: Solo Exhibition: May 20 - July 11, 2027 and $7,500 in cash award

All entries must be submitted through the CaFE website. Entries will be accepted starting October 1st through December 14, 2026. Only US based artists, 19 years of age and older are eligible to apply. All work submitted must be available for exhibition and be categorized as paintings.

items.name: Magazine Cover Art Feature: PJAS, Winter 2027 Issue
items.shortDescription: The Pennsylvania Journal of Arts and Sciences (PJAS) is an independent curated journal presenting contemporary work across visual art, writing, and interdisciplinary practice. Submissions are reviewed on a rolling basis and considered for inclusion in the upcoming Winter 2027 'Vintage' Issue and future editorial releases.

items.name: The James Parker “Open Door” Grant
items.shortDescription: The James Parker “Open Door” Grant, hosted by Artspace Gallery in Richmond, VA, supports the growth of early-career, under-resourced, and underrepresented artists. The award provides up to $2,000 in direct funding, a 1-year Artspace Artist Membership ($480 value), dedicated mentorship, an Exhibition Committee Fellowship, and a culminating public exhibition or event in 2027–2028. Free to apply.
